parent_objective: design a richer fault/source-family capability-separable source branch after M1257 closes the local source-construction branch
blocked_by: M1257 identifies capability_separable_source_family_gap in the current source branch

public_gates: M1258 must preserve actor input contract
M1258 must not use private holdout
M1258 must keep proxy fault claims separate from true four-wheel/high-fidelity fault claims
M1258 must pre-register any later run with unchanged capability-separable thresholds
forbidden_shortcuts: do not add hidden parameters, fault labels, oracle outcomes, or search outputs to actor inputs
do not accept negative own-branch margins
do not claim current single-track proxies are true single-wheel or per-wheel faults

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs a new source-family evidence variable after M1257 closes the local source-construction branch
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, recurrent-belief, high-fidelity, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if the proposed run only changes timing/proposal budget without changing source family
stop if proxy fault labels would be overstated as true physical per-wheel faults
fallback_plan: if current v4 source config can be reused safely, pre-register one bounded no-training smoke
if the constructor cannot safely consume the richer config, pre-register an implementation-only compatibility milestone
if proxy fidelity is insufficient for the claim, route to high-fidelity simulator selection/design instead of mining

admission_evidence: M1257 closes the local source-construction branch
existing v4 source config contains richer proxy fault families and explicit high-fidelity claim boundaries
allowed_updates: one bounded next-run manifest if design admits it
status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review
next_stage_criteria: design identifies exact source config and runtime bounds
design admits or rejects one bounded no-training smoke

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1258 designs a source branch and does not test actor history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: future actor history tests remain blocked until source-positive cases exist
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If richer proxy fault design is insufficient, record it as a source-family/fidelity blocker rather than weakening thresholds.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, true high-fidelity fault, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: A richer fault/source-family branch using the existing v4 proxy-fault configuration is the next clean evidence variable after local source construction failed.
success_criteria: design identifies whether the existing v4 config can be used for a bounded smoke
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: design repeats a local timing/proposal/relocation tweak as the main change
design blurs current-model proxy faults with true per-wheel/high-fidelity faults
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs

commands.name: design
commands.command: write docs/m1258-paper-route-richer-fault-capability-source-design.md from M1257 synthesis and v4 source config

decision_rule: M1258 passes if it writes a richer-fault source design with clear proxy/high-fidelity boundaries and admits or rejects one bounded no-training smoke.
